description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named CacheController, which manages cache-related administrative functions such as displaying cache keys and clearing specific or all cache entries within a web application.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing cache operations such as viewing and clearing cache entries in an admin interface.

methods.name: displayAccounts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display current cache entries for a merchant store.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Handles POST requests to clear specific cache entries or the entire cache for a store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu-related attributes for the view rendering.
